description: Kommunale Wärmeplanung Stadt Köln (WFS) is a dataset listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by geoportal.stadt-koeln.de. The data represent the results and basics of the municipal heating planning of the city of Cologne. They show spatial information about the heat supply, the heat demand as well as the potentials and development prospects of a climate-neutral heat supply. Coverage: DE. The portal shows the English title as "Municipal Heat Planning City of Cologne (WFS)" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Geothermie, Grundwasserwärme, Paffrather Mulde, Gasnetz, Einsparpotenzial, Energieeffizienz. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.govdata.de/dl-de/zero-2-0). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
